description: This file defines the ARM AArch32-specific kernel interrupt handling interface for Zephyr OS, including function declarations, macros, and conditional mappings for custom interrupt controllers and architecture-specific features.

methods.name: arch_irq_enable
methods.description: Enables a specific IRQ line, mapped to either the default or custom controller.

methods.name: arch_irq_disable
methods.description: Disables a specific IRQ line, mapped to either the default or custom controller.

methods.name: arch_irq_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ line is enabled, mapped to either the default or custom controller.

methods.name: z_arm_irq_priority_set
methods.description: Sets the priority for a specific IRQ.

methods.name: arch_isr_direct_header
methods.description: Handles tracing at the start of a direct ISR.

methods.name: arch_isr_direct_footer
methods.description: Handles tracing and potential context switch at the end of a direct ISR.
